_comment: Repo-managed opencode permission block, merged into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json by /deploy-global (opencode scope). Additive and idempotent; a rule already present in the user's config wins. Leading ~ is expanded to $HOME at merge time so this file stays portable. Every entry is a directory opencode must reach WITHOUT an interactive prompt, because an unattended run (status-fetch, a spawned subagent) has nobody to answer it. `shell` pins the bash tool to Homebrew bash 5 (parity with CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL); it is added only when the user has no `shell` key and the binary exists.
